items.period: Mid Western Zhou attribution for the underlying form; the selected file is a modern drawing.
items.tradition: Bronze inscription form; modern vector redraw.
items.caption: This bronze-script form of 日 has a rounded rectangular outline with a filled mark at its center. It shows a later visible form of the sun pictogram; the image does not establish how the earliest graph was formed.
items.alt: A thick, rounded rectangular black outline surrounds a smaller filled black oval.
items.selection_reason: The clear outline and central mark make the character’s visible form easy to see. The source attributes this modern redraw to a mid-Western Zhou bronze form, but the drawing is not an artifact image and does not establish when these graphic features developed.
items.rights: CC0 1.0, as stated on the Commons file page; Xiaoxuetang query-interface glyph image and attribute data are also CC0 1.0 under its official notice.

limitations.text: The cited sources do not date the development of the rounded outline or central mark, or establish a detailed sequence of changes in 日’s shape.
